artifact_accounting.count_while_worker_active: The inner runner polls the full recovery output tree and kills the worker if the current file-byte total exceeds 20 MiB.
artifact_accounting.count_after_worker_before_runner_receipt: Recorded separately with its artifact manifest.
artifact_accounting.count_including_final_runner_receipt: The inner runner calculates exact UTF-8 receipt byte length, writes a fixed-width final count/status/return-code receipt, then rescans the full tree. A post-receipt cap excess sets status ARTIFACT_CAP_EXCEEDED and return code 125 in the same fixed-width receipt and process exit.
artifact_accounting.outer_supervisor_count: The v3 supervisor polls and measures the complete output tree, reports elapsed overrun, and returns a cap failure when an observed tree total exceeds 20 MiB. An independent outer execution harness is required to enforce a hard 60-second wall limit across the supervisor post-exit observations.
